findings.title: API inputs do not constrain transformed API revenues
findings.evidence: Negative and >100% shares create numeric API volumes; Anthropic 10% gross API share in Net mode gives negative net API despite input within0..100%.

findings.title: OpenAI source gross-up denominator is not explicit
findings.evidence: Source applies additive net receipts uplift1.10x API; if CSP20% is share of gross customer billings, exact uplift is1.125x. Correcting that conditional basis would raise API volume2.2727%. Not a proven error; preserve original and flag.

findings.title: Conditional API equivalents are not observed company consumption
findings.evidence: Company transfer of Ramp pricing remains unvalidated, residual cache/other is not measured caching, lower benchmark uses a different token universe. Formula reconciliation cannot independently validate real traffic.

formula_audit.method: Independent stdlib recursive formula evaluation from OOXML; default caches compared. Not native Excel execution. The known artifact-tool zero-vs-blank engine defect is separately tested by root.
